# Competition

<!-- STEP id="rivals" -->
In a market economy, many sellers offer similar goods. On one street, three umbrella sellers compete for the same buyers. Each one tries to offer a lower price or a better umbrella.

<!-- STEP id="ideas" -->
Competition pushes sellers to improve. One seller brings a folding umbrella that fits in a school bag, and the others soon follow. The book names the United States of America, Japan and Hong Kong as market economies. Even there, the government plays an important role.

**Competition encourages better quality, lower prices and new ideas.**
